directive.quote: The judge answers a Book 3 call within the engine's output limit: its questions come as one entry a rule in pages, and a question not yet settled is one finding a unit, not one a row. A 346-character unit against 446 voice rows answered 393,216 bytes (a question text, a finding and a line a row, each carrying the unit's whole text) and the engine killed the run at its 262,144-byte output bound (workshop_run_outcome_unknown, output_limit). Now the ask is said once a rule, what every rule shares once in ask_all, a unit's words never copied, pages of at most 20,000 bytes with questions_after for the next; 1,200 rows answer 25 pages of at most 24,820 bytes. Tests: answer-size.test.mjs 5 added (446 and 1,200 rows, pages cover every question once, answers by id pass and fail the unit, bad cursor refused); branch, rules-and-verdicts and tool-row tests updated to the new shape.
